kind: Automatic saved inventory restoration plus exact single-block/container rollback and chat output repair

checks.commandAdapter: Production handler with API/storage doubles: selection, coordinates/dimensions, locked time/position, neighbor isolation, automatic container quantities, concrete slot preview, stale inventory, claims, cancellation, durable intents and failed recipients
checks.sql: Production SQLite queries: exact-cell all-actor selection, dimensions/world, baseline inventory and later conflicts; 30 seeded equivalence fixtures
checks.browser: Owner/ReadOnly and Safe Diagnostics; risk/backup acknowledgements; retained/snapshot preview/stage and changed-input invalidation; 390px layout

limits: Live restoration used deliberately seeded fixtures in disposable world copies, not production damage or authenticated clients.

Single-block rollback command execution was tested through the production handler with API/storage doubles and actual SQLite query fixtures; no authenticated-client end-to-end rollback session was run.
Retained fixture preserved a synthetic text attribute on a serialized stack; full payload bytes were compared before/after.
Historical snapshots record codes/quantities only. New stacks receive default attributes; missing written text, durability, freshness and bag contents cannot be recreated.
Saved restoration requires compatible surviving vanilla metadata and the inspected official server codec; unsupported/custom or oversized data is refused.

An earlier normal-engine probe timed out during concurrent server startup. The test probe now pins its requested column and polls for up to 60 seconds, then unloads the owned column. Both final-build reruns passed.
